text:
Your agent fails at one step and the whole run is a black box again.
Langfuse is open source tracing for LLM apps, showing every call in the run.
• Each LLM call shows up as a trace with tokens, latency, and cost
• Prompt management with versions you can roll back
• Evals and datasets, so a prompt change is tested before it ships
• Self host with Docker Compose if the data cannot leave your box
For builders shipping agents who are guessing why a run got slow or expensive.
https://langfuse.com
